description: This file defines an interface called IConsistentRingStreamQueueMapper used for mapping ring ranges to stream queues in Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes a method to retrieve queue identifiers for a given ring range.

classes.name: IConsistentRingStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: An interface responsible for mapping ring ranges to stream queues, designed to be thread-safe.

methods.name: GetQueuesForRange
methods.description: Returns the collection of QueueId objects that correspond to the specified IRingRange.
